results.assessment: Linear Regression meets both success criteria. Small train/validation gap confirms no overfitting. Underfitting is the main limitation — model cannot capture non-linear degradation patterns.
Random Forest meets both success criteria. However large train/validation RMSE gap of 13.30 indicates significant overfitting. Validation performance still improves over baseline.
XGBoost meets both success criteria and improves over Random Forest on validation RMSE. Built-in regularization slightly reduces overfitting gap compared to Random Forest.
XGBoost Tuned achieves the best validation RMSE and R2 among all models. Hyperparameter tuning successfully improved generalization. Both success criteria are met comfortably.

overall_conclusion: All four models meet the defined success criteria (RMSE below 20.0 and R2 above 0.75). XGBoost Tuned is selected as the best model with validation RMSE=17.4496 and R2=0.8248. Model performance is considered sufficient to proceed to Analytical Pipeline Development.
